env._comment: Baked into the bundle at build time — changing the server means rebuilding the APK. HTTPS via Let's Encrypt on an Elastic IP, so neither an instance stop/start nor a cert renewal changes it. Must be the nginx origin (443), never :3000: the API is loopback-bound. app.json no longer sets usesCleartextTraffic, so this MUST stay https:// — a plain-http URL here would be blocked by Android at runtime.
